scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build -w codemirror-helix-cm6-playground && npm run build -w codemirror-helix-cm5-playground
scripts.build:lib: npm run build -w codemirror-helix-core && npm run build -w codemirror-helix && npm run build -w codemirror-helix-cm5
scripts.lint: npm exec --no prettier -- --check . && npm exec --no eslint
scripts.test: npm run test -w codemirror-helix-core && npm run test -w codemirror-helix-cm5 && npm run test -w codemirror-helix
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w codemirror-helix-core && npm run typecheck -w codemirror-helix-core && npm run typecheck -w codemirror-helix && npm run typecheck -w codemirror-helix-cm5
scripts.pack:check: npm pack -w codemirror-helix-core --dry-run && npm pack -w codemirror-helix-cm5 --dry-run
